body:
So I popped Nirvana's 'Unplugged in NY' in my CD player, and heard one of my favorite songs 'Pennyroyal Tea'.  My grandmother actually grows these plants in her garden.  So, being the curious person that I am, I decided to cut off the leaves and brew them in to this 'Pennyroyal Tea' that Kurt delightfully sings about.  Little did I know I was in for an experience like none other that I have ever experienced, and my drug use has been very extensive.
About forty five minutes after drinking this tea, which actually tasted very pleasant, a pretty strong euphoria set in, comparable with (but not quite as intense) as that rush I experince right when the dope hits my veins.  This was coupled by a speedy effect.  It was like a speedball.  All my cares were gone; life was perfect.  This feeling, however, disappeared in about forty-five minutes, yet was replaced by a hallucinogenic stage coupled with a major body buzz.  Wow.  I could hardly move, yet I felt incredible.  The third stage, as I have become fond of calling it, came about two to three hours later.  I felt disassociated from myself, like I was watching what I was doing.  It was almost exactly like I feel after smoking some PCP.  It was crazy.  I could do anything.  And finally, the most dreaded part of any drug experience, the comedown.  Surprisingly, the comedown was almost as incredible as the coming up!  I was very sensitive to touch, and very peaceful, almost as if I had smoked some grass.  I went right to sleep.  The next morning when I woke up, I still felt very euphoric, and this lasted well into the day.  I experienced no type of hangover.  This tea was unbelievable.
Never, ever have I experienced anything like this.  It was perfect.  I have started cultivating Pennyroyal in my own garden, and I have been reaping the rewards ever since.  I know understand why Kurt would always 'Sit and drink Pennyroyal Tea'.
